topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I just got a request from my neighbor, Sam, asking if he could use a corner of my yard for a garden. It’s a big decision for me. I mean, I like Sam, and he seems to know a lot about gardening. Maybe it would be nice to have some fresh vegetables and herbs nearby. But at the same time, I worry about how it might affect my property. What if something goes wrong? I need to think this through carefully before I give him an answer. I’ll probably need to do some research or maybe talk to other neighbors who’ve done something similar.
